text: MART 498 Maritime Medical Care Provider Credits: 2. 1 Lecture Hour. 3 Lab Hours. Overview: 1 Lecture Hour. 3 Lab Hours. Basic and advanced training for medical care of the sick and injured in the maritime environment; fundamentals of identification and assessment of and appropriate interventions for life-threats and other medical or trauma related conditions commonly encountered at sea; must complete course within one year of graduation. Prerequisites: MART majors - Grade of C or better in MART 300 , MART 350 , or NAUT 300 , or concurrent enrollment or approval of MART department head; MARE majors - Grade of C or better in MARR 300, MARE 300 , or MARE 350 , or concurrent enrollment or approval of MART department head.
